reason: I hunt easy claims, but a free site asking me to make an account for unverified settlement listings is exactly the data-grab vibe I got from that TikTok. I still have to file the claim myself on some other site, so I'm not handing over my email for a list I don't trust.
objection: Is this a scam or just farming my info? Unverified listings plus a free account is a hard no until I know who actually runs this.
would_change_my_mind: Let me browse without an account, and make every listing a straight link to the official administrator notice I'd already trust — or have my bank or a known consumer group stand behind it.
